_doc: CodexMemory — Visual and simulation config for the neural graph. Edit here to adjust behavior without touching code.

neuron._doc_foundationScale: Size multiplier for the foundation neuron (context_1.md) relative to the base radius. Default: 5
neuron._doc_normalScale: Size multiplier for regular neurons relative to the base radius. Default: 2.82
neuron._doc_minSpacing: Minimum distance (world units) between neurons inside an area zone — Poisson-disk sampling. Default: 200
neuron._doc_maxSpacing: Maximum distance (world units) between neurons inside an area zone. Default: 600

area._doc_radiusScale: Multiplier for the base radius of each brain area zone. Higher values expand all zones uniformly. Default: 2.6
area._doc_toneSpread: Hue diversity within each area. 0 = all neurons share the exact base tone of the area; 1 = full palette range (~50°); values above 1 stretch beyond the palette bounds. Default: 2.0

idle._doc_enabled: Enable (true) or disable (false) idle animation for neurons. The foundation neuron never oscillates regardless of this value.
idle._doc_tickSpeed: flowTick increment per frame — controls overall speed of all animations (synapses, idle, flow). Default: 0.03
idle._doc_freqVariation: Maximum oscillation frequency variation between neurons. 0 = all oscillate at the same speed; 1 = 100% variation. Default: 1.0
idle._doc_yRatio: Ratio between vertical and horizontal idle frequency. Values other than 1.0 produce elliptical trajectories (Lissajous figure). Default: 1.0
